{{Quote|I can't believe there's anyone left... but you don't want to be out here alone.|Amari, to Lear|<ref name="Make It Stop" />}}
'''Amari''' was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[swamp trooper]]. By around [[18 BBY]], Amari had the rank of [[captain]] and participated in a [[Unidentified massacre (Luthen Rael)|massacre]] of the population of a [[Unidentified planet (Luthen Rael)|planet]]. During the violence, Amari attempted to locate [[Sergeant]] [[Luthen Rael|Lear]] and found him in their [[starship]]. Amari asked their fellow [[Imperial Army trooper|trooper]] what they were doing, and Lear replied that his converter had backed up. In reality, Lear was suffering a crisis of conscience and was preparing to help a [[Kleya Marki|young girl]], who had stowed away on the ship, escape the massacre. Amari told Lear not to take too long, saying that they did not want to be out amidst the violence alone. Lear responded that he would be right behind as Amari returned to action. Instead, Lear would [[Desertion|desert]] the Empire. Amari was a human with [[Color|brown]] skin and dark hair. A soldier of the [[Imperial Army]], Amari wielded an [[E-22 reciprocating double-barreled blaster rifle]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amari appeared in a flashback sequence of "[[Make It Stop]]," the tenth episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']]. The character was portrayed by [[Bailey Patrick]]. Although credited as "[[Corporal]] Amari" in the episode's credits, Amari is referred to as a captain in the episode.<ref name="Make It Stop" /> Patrick has also referred to the character as Corporal Amari in social media posts.<ref name="Amari05-12">{{Instagram|username=baileypatrick_official|url=p/DJin0PmoBRw|name=[[Bailey Patrick]]|date=2025-05-12|quote=Corporal Amari #andorseason2 #disneyplus #disney #starwars #andor #galaxy #monday #bts #baileypatrick|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/Gjht2|nolive=1}}</ref>
